206:t_1:86.en:
$$佐伯$$
「What are you saying? This problem is no longer something that ends with the survival of a single company.」

206:t_1:87.en:
$$赤木$$
「To keep it from coming to that, we'll give it everything we've got, and so will $$ダイ・ガード$$.」

206:t_1:88.en:
$$青山$$
「You're right. Having come this far, it's not about salarymen or anything like that. All of us Earthlings have no choice but to fight together.」

206:t_1:89.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's fine for us adults, but...」

206:t_1:90.en:
$$赤木$$
「What about $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ and the others... And everyone at $$陣代高校$$...」

206:t_1:91.en:
$$佐伯$$
「In all likelihood, the battles ahead are expected to be even fiercer than any so far.」

206:t_1:92.en:
$$佐伯$$
「They will most likely have to take a leave of absence from school and join the fighting.」

206:t_1:93.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So this is the end of $$宗介$$'s high school life, huh.」

206:t_1:94.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Everyone in the Volunteer Club... They've somehow managed to balance things until now, but it's finally at its limit, isn't it...」

206:t_1:95.en:
$$マオ$$
「...It's a shame, but it can't be helped. Miss $$スズネ$$'s teaching practice at $$陣代高校$$ is about to end soon, too...」

206:t_1:96.en:
$$青山$$
「$$陣代高校$$... I hear tomorrow is the closing ceremony for the third term.」

206:t_1:97.en:
$$葵$$
「So the Volunteer Club members will transfer out right after spring break, then.」

206:t_1:98.en:
$$朔哉$$
「...What are $$甲児$$ and the others doing?」

206:t_1:99.en:
$$大山$$
「Everyone except $$宗介$$ and $n is at the base, doing maintenance on their own units.」

206:t_1:100.en:
$$中原$$
「It looks like $$宗介$$ and the others went to school.」

206:t_1:102.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Those two... They did have a special attachment to school...」

206:t_1:103.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...It can't be helped. Not in a situation like this.」

206:t_1:104.en:
$$マオ$$
「Never mind $n, $$宗介$$ is just going back to his old life.」

206:t_1:105.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Though he's not the same kid he used to be...」

206:t_1:106.en:
$$クルツ$$
「As for $$カナメ$$'s bodyguard detail, we've got no choice but to leave it to the guys in the Intelligence Division.」

206:t_1:107.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$宗介$$ and $n... I hope they manage to find some closure...」

206:t_1:108.en:
$$赤木$$
($$シンジ$$... I hear the Volunteer Club is finished, too...)

206:t_1:109.en:
$$赤木$$
(But we're not giving up... We'll do our best to get back to a world where $$宗介$$ and the others can go to school again...)

206:t_1:110.en:
$$赤木$$
(So you hang in there, too... Wherever you are, you're a member of the Volunteer Club and a member of $c...)

206:t_1:115.en:
$$林水$$
「...I'm sorry, $$相良$$. I've taken up your time on a day when you've come to school for the first time in ages.」

206:t_1:116.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not at all... Congratulations on your graduation, Council President, sir.」

206:t_1:117.en:
$$林水$$
「That title takes a 'former' now. With graduation upon us, there's nothing to do but entrust the seat to the next generation.」

206:t_1:118.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I shall call you Former Council President, sir.」

206:t_1:119.en:
$$林水$$
「...What will you do? Will you serve as the Council President's Aide for Security Affairs in the new student council, too?」

206:t_1:120.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I have not decided as of now...」

206:t_1:122.en:
$$林水$$
「What about the Volunteer Club members today?」

206:t_1:123.en:
$$宗介$$
「They are swamped with the cleanup from the other day's operation, so I am the only one attending school today.」

206:t_1:124.en:
$$林水$$
「Then let's get to the main matter I called you in for.」

206:t_1:126.en:
$$林水$$
「It's been a year since you... since all of you came to $$陣代高校$$. All sorts of things have happened, from small commotions to grave and serious incidents.」

206:t_1:127.en:
$$林水$$
「I have refrained from any needless prying into how those matters relate to you, and whenever it was necessary, I believe I've made accommodations each time.」

206:t_1:128.en:
$$林水$$
「If I may be so bold, I also assisted with Miss $$スズネ$$'s activity reports to the school, in my capacity as Student Council President.」

206:t_1:130.en:
$$林水$$
「There was no calculation behind it. I simply meant it as goodwill between friends.」

206:t_1:131.en:
$$林水$$
「But... I think it is about to become untenable.」

206:t_1:133.en:
$$林水$$
「Even among the Volunteer Club, you in particular have learned well how to get along with society here, and have grown a great deal.」

206:t_1:134.en:
$$林水$$
「Given the situation up until autumn, I thought there would be no problem if you kept up your efforts.」

206:t_1:135.en:
$$林水$$
「But the state of the world is coming to not allow that... No, I should say it already does not.」

206:t_1:136.en:
$$林水$$
「And the one who is becoming a major problem in all this is her... $$千鳥$$.」

206:t_1:138.en:
$$林水$$
「She is always at the center of it. In every truly serious incident at this $$陣代高校$$, without exception...」

206:t_1:139.en:
$$林水$$
「At first I thought the cause was her father's post, High Commissioner for the Environment of the $$地球連邦$$, but that doesn't explain it.」

206:t_1:140.en:
$$林水$$
「And the other factor is your absence whenever the incidents occurred, and a $$地球連邦軍$$ special forces unit called $c...」

206:t_1:142.en:
$$林水$$
「I have no intention of prying any further, but I think it's only a matter of time before other people start making a fuss.」

206:t_1:143.en:
$$林水$$
「And both Miss $$スズネ$$ and I will be gone next month. We will no longer be able to help you as we have until now.」

206:t_1:144.en:
$$林水$$
「It is inevitable that things will accelerate as the world transforms... In other words, time is running out... You should talk with her.」

206:t_1:145.en:
$$林水$$
「If you don't... you'll be tormented by terrible regret afterward.」

206:t_1:147.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's not just me. $n, $$アルト$$, $$甲児$$, everyone...」

206:t_1:148.en:
$$林水$$
「...So do I. They're all people worth loving. ...They are simple and good-hearted, but they are still ordinary human beings.」

206:t_1:149.en:
$$林水$$
「They get frightened, and they get anxious. And... they can become cruel.」

206:t_1:151.en:
$$林水$$
「...But perhaps it's not a problem to be so pessimistic about. This is, after all, just a school... It's merely a waypoint.」

206:t_1:153.en:
$$林水$$
「It's easy to forget... but life goes on, for decades to come.」

206:t_1:160.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Hey, $$相良$$. Is the ex-Student Council President's last lecture over?」

206:t_1:161.en:
$$風間$$
「That took a long time. Morning classes are already over.」

206:t_1:162.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「The afternoon is prep for tomorrow's closing ceremony. In other words, our last class as second-years is over and done.」

206:t_1:164.en:
$$恭子$$
「Are you shocked, by any chance?」

206:t_1:165.en:
$$詩織$$
「You've missed so much school already, so I think it's a little late for that, but...」

206:t_1:166.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「So, aren't $$アルト$$ and the others coming today?」

206:t_1:167.en:
$$宗介$$
「Those guys are still working on-site.」

206:t_1:168.en:
$$詩織$$
「What a bind... It seems everyone has loads of things they want to ask the Volunteer Club for during spring break...」

206:t_1:169.en:
$$恭子$$
「I also wanted to hand over the Valentine's chocolates I've been holding for $$アルト$$ and $n, but...」

206:t_1:170.en:
$$風間$$
「I had a promise from $$兜$$ to treat me to Galaxy Ramen, too...」

206:t_1:171.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Forget that, what about Miss $$スズネ$$! Her special teaching practice is over now, and there isn't even a chance to say goodbye?!」

兜.evidence: Kazama calls Kouji Kabuto by surname alone; no surname-only token in the sheet; glossary has 兜甲児 = Kouji Kabuto

kept_omissions: 206:t_1:171: who cannot say goodbye (Suzune to the class, or the class to Suzune) is not settled; kept impersonal
